rows.en: Then how about we make the first move?
Fight the Death Army?
Fight the Death Army?
...!! The one in this capsule... Could it be...!?
...? The one in this capsule...
...What's this? The guy in this capsule...
...What's this? The guy in this capsule...
...? The one in this capsule...
...Hm? The guy in this capsule...
Inside the capsule appears to be a Gundam-type mobile suit.
Heh heh heh... Curious about the one inside, are you?
...Master Gundam!!
...Master Gundam!!
...Master Gundam!!
...Master Gundam!!
...Master Gundam!!

...Master Gundam!!

...Master Gundam!!
...Master Gundam!!
That one is "Gundam Epyon."
Gundam Epyon...!!
I first brought him here for my own experiments, but now he is a test subject for the "Zero System."
Hah hah hah hah hah...!!
So you're even researching the Zero System!!
The Zero System...!? What is that!?
The Zero System...!? What is that!?
The Zero System...!? What is that!?
The Zero System...!? What is that!?

The Zero System...!? What is that!?
The Zero System...!? What is that!?
The Zero System...!? What is that!?
If you wish to know, ask Reborns Gundam! My sole devotion is to the Devil Gundam.
Fuhahahahaha!!
So you were in league with Reborns too!!
So you were in league with Reborns too!!
So you were in league with Reborns too!!
So you were in league with Reborns too!!
I knew it! You've been working with Reborns too!

So you were working with Reborns too!!
So you were working with Reborns too, after all!!
Knew it! You're in cahoots with Reborns too, huh!
So you were in league with Reborns too!!
So you were in league with Reborns too!!
I knew it! You've been working with Reborns too!
So you were cozying up to Reborns too, huh!
Oh my, I have said too much...
Be that as it may, I can no longer tolerate those who stand in my way!!
Come forth!! Jark Midora!!
...!! Jark Midora...!?
This one was once an executive of the Crisis Empire... He was revived by the power of DG Cells.
He fell short as a test subject for my research, but he is more than strong enough to defeat you lot!!
A Crisis executive, with DG Cells...!! This one's going to be tough...
A Crisis executive revived with DG Cells!! He looks like a tough one!!
A Crisis executive revived by DG Cells... This is a formidable enemy.
A Crisis executive revived by DG Cells... This looks like it'll be tough...
A Crisis executive, with DG Cells...!? Honestly, what a troublesome enemy you've brought back.
A Crisis big shot brought back with DG Cells? Sounds fun! Now that's a worthy opponent!!
A Crisis executive revived by DG Cells... He seems badly distorted...
A Crisis executive revived by DG Cells... Target confirmed!
A Crisis executive revived by DG Cells... Looks like a tough opponent...
A Crisis executive revived by DG Cells... Looks like a tough opponent...

notes.note: Ankh proposes attacking the Death Army that is not moving (answers the leader lines 0635 #0.61-74 in story_120). 'we' restored.

#0.1-6 = TextIdOffset+0+k; 0640.bla chain 9,10,8,6,7, default 36: Wing Zero (recognises Epyon), 00, God, Nu, Zeta, else Ankh (CHARA 36) speaks #0.6. Identical JP -> identical EN (#0.2/#0.5, #0.3/#0.4). Lines trail off because the narration #0.9 cuts in.
#0.11-25 = +10+k; chain 8,9,10,6,7,13,12,11,15,14,3,2,1,5,4 = God, Wing Zero, 00, Nu, Zeta, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, Zero, Mebius, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, OOO, W. All identical.
Speaker is Wing Zero, not W (Shotaro): script runs +26 only if Pt_Chara_Check(9), as the leader or with Wing Zero's portrait loaded. Same for #0.31.
Epyon (Zechs, g=m) referred to as 'him'. Zero System quoted because the source sets it in corner brackets.
Only +31 (#0.32) is called (when Wing Zero is absent; the leader speaks). #0.33-45 are never called by 0640.bla; translated the same anyway, #0.41 rougher wording for its rougher Japanese.
'Devil Gundam hitosuji' rendered as 'My sole devotion is to the Devil Gundam' (Master Asia cares only for the Devil Gundam, not the Zero System).

#0.48-62 = +47+k with the #0.11 chain order: God, Wing Zero, 00, Nu, Zeta(#0.52), Taro, Seven, Ultraman, Zero, Mebius(#0.57), Den-O(#0.58), RX, Rider 1, OOO(#0.61), W(#0.62). If 00 is in the party, 00 says #0.48. Kisama rows share one EN, omae rows another; #0.58 Momotaros 'guru' = in cahoots; #0.62 Shotaro's contemptuous -yagatta = 'cozying up to'. The extractor's W (Shotaro) labels on this block are placeholders.
Speaker is Black RX (script: Pt_Chara_Check(2), RX's portrait), not W; RX knows Jark from the Crisis Empire. Played only if RX is in the party.

#0.71 = RX when in party; otherwise a leader chain picks the line: God->#0.71, Wing Zero->#0.78, 00->#0.77, Nu->#0.79, Zeta->#0.80, Taro..Mebius->#0.81-85 (next slice), Den-O->#0.76, Rider 1->#0.75, OOO->#0.74, W->#0.73 spoken by W (Philip) (CHARA 198). The extractor's W (Shotaro) labels are wrong.
Not called by 0640.bla (God's branch points to #0.71); likely God's intended line. Translated anyway.
Rider 1. 'yomigaerasete kureta' read as sarcastic, aimed at Master Gundam: 'what a troublesome enemy you've brought back'.
00 (Setsuna): 'distorted' kept for the series' distortion motif.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader blocks mapped from 0640.bla branches; extractor speaker labels W (Shotaro) wrong for #0.27/#0.31 (Wing Zero), #0.66/#0.71 (RX), #0.73 (Philip). Unused variants: #0.33-45, #0.72. No new names.
